title: 第15章 狩猎第16章 遇难
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
“这就是穷奇的力量吗！”
邬童挥动着双拳，激动道：“我从未感觉过如此恐怖的力量！”
“哇，邬童哥变得好高啊！”
一旁的青青围着邬童兴奋的叫道。
“哈哈，来！”
邬童大笑着把青青抱起，放在自己肩膀上。
“我也要，我也要！”
一旁的一些五六岁的孩子都缠着邬童。
阿皓苗玫几个稍微大一些的少年都轻笑的看着这一幕。
现在族内已经没有大人了，所以他们必须要成为大人，让这帮孩子们去依靠。
结束了一番玩闹，微微冲淡了一些悲伤的氛围。
此刻阿皓看着邬童那消失的血纹，身体缓缓恢复原样，满面红光的朝他走来，才意识到邬童此时的状态，身体形态变化并没有对他造成多大的负担，心中暗道甲级血兽确实可怕。
“明日一早，等那九铁玄鳇走后，咱俩去一趟恶魔林边缘，我用我的鹰眼视觉，咱俩配合狩猎速度会大大加快。”
阿皓计划着。
“好！”
邬童有些期待的答道，他迫不及待想去试试如今自己的实力到底到达什么程度了。
“多带一个人就多一份风险，按照咱们俩的速度尽量一个月内把口粮，柴火等准备齐全。”
次日一早，在伙伴们的祝福下，阿皓和邬童二人来到了江边岩石后，看着那水下黑影向南游去，邬童一把扛起木筏丢到江上，笑嘻嘻的拍着木筏：“上船！”
阿皓白了他一眼，这货膨胀了。
不得不说，在邬童的巨力下，二人只用了半炷香的时间就抵达对岸。

收好木筏后，顺道看了眼路北和小四，在路北忧心忡忡的眼神下得知还没有那十六和路南的消息。
此时邬童看着路北的样子，也没了刚刚准备分享好消息的喜悦。
四人沉默片刻，阿皓道：“还有一天时间，明日你们就跟我俩一起回去吧，然后每天我和邬童都会过来查看。
放心吧路北，你哥你也知道，做事沉稳，和你大大咧咧的不一样，而且那十六的观察力没的说，就连我都赶不上他，他们一定会没事的。”
“嗯嗯，我相信他们。”
路北点头答道，但还是能看出他此时心事重重。
“喝。”
邬童此时吸了口气，胸口黑光浮现，“给哥们看个新鲜的，我叫他穷奇形态！”
说着话间就变成了昨日的三米形态。
“这……”
在路北和小四一顿傻眼中，阿皓解释了邬童昨日已经成为了壹纹战士。
“甲级血兽？”
小四惊问道。
路北此时也是被邬童那模样吓了一跳，听阿皓这么一说，脸色一变，谄媚的走到阿皓身边。
“哎呦～族长，我怎么感觉我这几天在野外的锻炼，气血翻了又翻，您看……”
路北锤着阿皓的肩膀。
阿皓被他这出激起一身鸡皮疙瘩。
他早就用山海经对族内所有伙伴尝试过，就算山海经中最低级的血兽都显示着“条件尚未符合”
阿皓推测应该是山海经中记载的异兽或许特殊，对于战士的气血要求非常之高，目前除了邬童所有人都还为满足条件。
如此想着瞄了眼此时还在炫耀的邬童，这货这几年其实就是个炊事员。

“行啦，别显摆了，正事还没办呢。”
阿皓制止了邬童这种没营养的行为。
content_en:
"Is this the power of Qiongqi!"
Wu Tong waved his fists and said excitedly: "I have never felt such terrifying power!"
"Wow, Brother Wu Tong has become so tall!"
Qingqing on the side shouted excitedly around Wu Tong.
"Haha, come on!"
Wu Tong laughed and picked up Qingqing and put it on his shoulders.
"I want it too, I want it too!"
Some five or six-year-old children on the side were pestering Wu Tong.
Ahao Miaomei and several older teenagers all looked at this scene with chuckles.
Now there are no adults in the clan, so they must become adults for these children to rely on.
It ended the fun and slightly diluted some of the sad atmosphere.
At this moment, Ah Hao looked at Wu Tong's disappearing blood lines, his body slowly returned to its original shape, and he walked towards him with a red face. Only then did he realize Wu Tong's current state. The change in body shape did not put much burden on him. He secretly thought in his heart that the Class A blood beast was indeed terrifying.
"Tomorrow morning, after the Nine Iron Black Tortoise leaves, we will go to the edge of the Devil's Forest. I will use my eagle vision, and our hunting speed will be greatly accelerated."
Ah Hao planned.
"Okay!"
Wu Tong replied with some anticipation. He couldn't wait to test how far his strength had reached now.
"One more person brings more risks. According to the speed of the two of us, we will try to prepare all the rations, firewood, etc. within a month."
Early the next morning, with the blessings of their friends, Ahao and Wu Tong came to the rocks on the riverside and watched the dark figure swimming southward. Wu Tong picked up the raft and threw it onto the river. He patted the raft with a smile and said, "Get on the boat!"
Ah Hao rolled his eyes at him, this guy was swollen.
It has to be said that with Wu Tong's great strength, the two of them reached the other side in only half the time of burning incense.
After putting away the raft, he took a look at Lu Bei and Xiao Si. Under Lu Bei's worried eyes, he learned that there was no news about Shiliu and Lu Nan.
At this time, Wu Tong looked at Lu Bei, and the joy that he had just prepared to share the good news was gone.
The four of them were silent for a moment, and Ah Hao said: "There is still one day left, you can go back with me tomorrow, and then Wu Tong and I will come over every day to check.
Don't worry, Lu Bei. You also know that your brother is calm in doing things, which is different from you who are careless. Moreover, that sixteen's observation skills are incredible. Even I can't catch up with him. They will be fine. "
"Yeah, I believe them."
Lu Bei nodded and replied, but it could still be seen that he was worried at this time.
"Drink."
Wu Tong took a breath at this time, and a black light appeared on his chest, "Show me a new one, I'll call him Qiongqi form!"
As he spoke, he changed into the three-meter form yesterday.
"This..."
When Lu Bei and Xiao Si were dumbfounded, A Hao explained that Wu Tong had become a Yiwen warrior yesterday.
"Class A blood beast?"
Xiaosi asked in surprise.
Lu Bei was also startled by Wu Tong's appearance at this time. After hearing what A Hao said, his expression changed and he walked to A Hao flatteringly.
"Ouch~ Patriarch, why do I feel that my energy and blood have been boiling over and over again after exercising in the wild these past few days? Look..."
Lu Bei hammered Ah Hao's shoulder.
Ah Hao was aroused by his words and got goosebumps all over his body.
He had already tried using the Classic of Mountains and Seas against all his friends in the clan, and even the lowest-level blood beast in the Classic of Mountains and Seas showed "the conditions have not yet been met."
Ah Hao speculated that the strange beasts recorded in the Classic of Mountains and Seas may be special. They have very high requirements for the blood of warriors. At present, everyone except Wu Tong has not met the requirements.
With this thought, he glanced at Wu Tong, who was still showing off at this moment. This guy has actually been a cook in the past few years.
"Okay, stop showing off, we haven't gotten down to business yet."
Ah Hao stopped Wu Tong's useless behavior.
